text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, even after training ended, Neo 
Universe showed no sign of leaving.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"CDR"... Clear skies. Celsius is 
favorable. The "magnetar" is affecting a 
wide area.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Transmission to the "synapse" is "Alpha 
Star." You can reach a "mixed state."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sphira... Can I become a free electron? 
Requesting... Trainer's authentication.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Nn... "SIM" has been tested. ...We can 
anticipate exponential growth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the environment is perfect for 
training right now. She looks eager to do 
even more training.
choice_data_list:

thing.

Let's call it a day and get some proper 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""METI" is good. Trainer, this opportunity 
is "unmissable", right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, she dashed off with a spring in 
her step. Looking somewhat happy, Neo 
Universe threw herself into additional 
solo training.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Priority" recommended at default value? 
...I haven't run a "SIM" for that.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, "Phase 0" is also effective. I 
shall "return" for today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeming satisfied, Neo Universe tidied up 
and headed home.
